text_block_list.text: I brought Katsuragi Ace to the infirmary after she got injured during training.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! This is nothing, really.
I know my own body best.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
So don't make that face.
Come on! Let's get back to training, yeah?
choice_data_list: No, I know more about you than you do yourself.
No, I know more about you than you do yourself.
Well then, let's give it a try...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
So don't make that face.
Come on! Let's get back to training, yeah?
choice_data_list: No, I know more about you than you do yourself.
No, I know more about you than you do yourself.
Well then, let's give it a try...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Ohh... You said it with total conviction!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Staying up late looking over my data, and facing me like this.
I guess you're the real "Katsuragi Ace" expert here.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Alright, got it! The rest of the time I'll focus on recovering.
...Sorry for making you fuss over me.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: All right, nice! How about something like this then?

"If anything happens, I'll back her up right away."
With that resolve, I followed after her, and—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"I'll study up by watching race footage of my rivals.
This way, you won't have to worry, right?"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Damn it, I shouldn't be watching this when I can't even run.
Watching those guys blazing ahead...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Getting worked up on its own, my legs are tensing up...!

I instructed Katsuragi Ace to rest
so her injury wouldn't get any worse.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Now then, which one should we check out first?
I always have a hard time deciding at times like this.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Haha! As expected of you, Trainer.
Always well-prepared!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's do some studying to get ready for my comeback!
And so, she was able to make a great start toward her comeback!
